messages:
sanjay: Heads-up: spike of 5xx from /v1/generate on the legacy model route. Dashboard shows ~12% error rate over 3m. Latency looks stable. Propose an emergency shim: pin route + inject header to force fallback pool. Can we flip via console toggle now? @kevin (oncall)

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-821: routing-fallback. Paging @kevin.

kevin: Oncall here. Can we do a hot toggle without breaking dedicated clusters? What's the blast radius?

maria: If we flip a header override we avoid the KV-cache mismatch that's likely causing the 5xx. Plan suggestion:
1) Add header `X-RF-Mode: fallback`
2) Set route weight -> legacy-pool (100%) for affected route
3) Short TTL for rollout (60s)
4) Watch token burn and quota telemetry (per-route).

alex: I can run the toggle with the internal routing API. I'll do a dry-run first. Will watch the routing and error dashboards. Security -- header injection is internal-only, should be fine.

sanjay: Do the dry-run then apply if the dry-run preview is clean. Dashboards: https://console.internal/dashboards/routing/legacy-fallback (watch error-rate / p50 / quota burn). Set an alert: error-rate >5% or p50 >250ms.

alex: Dry-run command (preview):
```
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/v1/routing/preview" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","action":"set_override","override":{"headers":{"X-RF-Mode":"fallback"},"weight":"legacy-pool:100","ttl":60}}'
```

kevin: Running dry-run now.

ops-runbook-bot: Dry-run result: 200 OK - preview applied, no conflicting rules detected. No additional approvals required.

alex: Applying toggle now to us-west-2 only (staged rollout):
```
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/v1/routing/apply" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","scope":"region:us-west-2","action":"set_override","override":{"headers":{"X-RF-Mode":"fallback"},"weight":"legacy-pool:100","ttl":60}}'
```
Response: 202 Accepted - rollout started.

maria: Seeing error-rate drop in us-west-2: 12% -> 1.8% within 90s. p50 stable. Good sign. Keep observing for 5m before promoting global.

kevin: Hold for 5m. If stable, roll to us-east then eu-west with 2m gaps. If any new errors >5% or token burn spikes, use `rollback=true` flag on apply to undo.

sanjay: Filing a follow-up: update Console rollouts UX ticket #324 to add a one-click 'Emergency shim' that does header pin + staged rollout. Current flow is too many manual steps for incidents.

alex: Will watch and escalate. If I see any service degradation I'll flip rollback and post logs here. Thanks. :thumbsup:

kevin: Thanks everyone. If global roll completes and metrics stay good, we'll close INC-2026-821 and draft a short postmortem with root-cause hypothesis (KV mismatch + model variant).

maria: Also adding a telemetry note: create a short-lived synthetic that exercises legacy-path to detect recurrence automatically.

kevin: Closing loop: us-east rolled, eu-west rolled, global metrics back to baseline. Marking incident RESOLVED in 30m after quiet window.

sanjay: Great work. Follow-up actions: UX ticket #324, telemetry synthetic, and add an ops-runbook snippet for header-shim rollback.
